steps.text: Polling units open at 8:30 AM. Accreditation and voting start together and end at 2:30 PM.
quotes: Polling units open nationwide at 8:30 AM
Accreditation and voting commence simultaneously and conclude at 2:30 PM

steps.text: If you are on the queue by 2:30 PM, you are entitled to vote.
quotes: every voter on the queue on or before 2:30 PM is entitled to vote

steps.text: No PVC, no voting. Bring your own Permanent Voter Card. You must be there in person and be verified on the BVAS device.
quotes: Ensure you have your physical Permanent Voter Card (PVC) with you.
All voters must be physically present and verified through the BVAS device.

steps.text: Go to the polling unit where you are registered and join the queue.
quotes: Arrive at your registered Polling Unit and join the orderly queue.

steps.text: An election official scans your PVC on the BVAS, which then checks your fingerprint. If the fingerprint check fails, it checks your face instead.
quotes: who scans the card details on the BVAS reader
The BVAS captures and verifies your fingerprint biometrics. If fingerprint capture fails, facial recognition authentication is instantly deployed.

steps.text: An official checks your name on the register, marks it, then signs, stamps and hands you your ballot paper.
quotes: verifies your name on the register, marks the register, signs and stamps the official ballot paper, and hands it to you.

steps.text: Mark your ballot in private in the voting cubicle, fold it, and put it in the ballot box.
quotes: Proceed to the private voting cubicle.
Fold your ballot vertically inward and drop it into the designated ballot box.

steps.text: After voting you may leave, or stay at least 300 metres away to watch the count and the announcement of results.
quotes: You may leave or remain at least 300 meters away to observe open counting and results announcement.
